label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. One land user reports four years of safe use, but cancellation requires two distinct reliable first-hand sources each reporting at least five years. The survey team could not see the interior on either visit, and the bus driver does not know the land; there is no target evidence supporting clearance, and the evidence is insufficient to cancel.
flags: For the next visit, seek additional first-hand information from people who use or know the interior and make reasonable efforts to access and assess the area; do not treat the zone flag or survey priority as evidence.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: has hunted and fished along the streams in the area every year for the past 4 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E1.note: A first-hand land user reports repeated safe use, supporting absence; one source and four years do not satisfy cancellation criteria.

E2.quote: could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E2.note: The team's limited access means it observed no interior land and provides neither presence evidence nor evidence of absence.

E3.quote: he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E3.note: The informant explicitly lacks knowledge of the interior, so this does not bear on EO presence or absence there.
